source_snapshot.procedure: Changes threshold FF5 to FFE and injects fixed IOHUB group7/struct1 errortype1 followed by immediate reset.
source_snapshot.criteria: Tool PASS and post-boot OS uncorrectable report.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; volatile logs do not identify a fresh durable source across reset.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires tuple/flag/threshold authority, BERT freshness and boot recovery.

old_problem: Proprietary IOHUB target and errortype1 semantics, FF5/FFE threshold encoding, expected reset branch and fresh MCA/BERT/CPER signature are all undefined.
disposition_reason: Generic MCA/CPER standards cannot decode AMD group7/struct1, tool errortype1 or threshold bits. These determine target, severity, reset and rollback, so they are core engineering semantics rather than safe parameters. ED-03/12/16/18 prohibit guessing or forcing a reset. Pending/BLOCKED remains until authoritative CPU/tool and platform contracts exist.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row70, exact AI/history2470, CE companion and next UCP row71.
Preserved IOHUB ECC UCE, immediate reset, multi-OS durable evidence and raw restoration coverage.
Required fresh CPER/BERT identity and OOB timeline because volatile logs disappear at reset.
Separated threshold behavior from the single UCE stimulus and demanded complete raw rollback.
No register change, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: IOHUB ECC UCE reset with fresh durable source evidence
test_case.purpose: Inject one authoritative IOHUB ECC UCE into each approved structure, verify the signed reset branch and one fresh source-correlated MCA/BERT/CPER record, then recover I/O and restore all controls.
required_package: Vendor IOHUB tuple/group/struct and errortype1 contract
Threshold register definition/mask and FF5/FFE rationale
OS-specific durable MCA/BERT/CPER fields and timing
OOB boot/reimage, IO recovery and exact configuration rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not alter threshold or inject. After approval, inventory persistent records and raw settings, apply only the documented masked threshold value, inject one verified target once under OOB capture, correlate the new durable source/severity through reset/boot, then restore and compare every setting and dependent I/O path.
test_case.expected_result: The intended source emits the approved UCE and reset response; exactly one fresh durable record matches the target/severity; firmware and OS boot within deadlines, IOHUB-dependent devices/services recover, and all raw settings equal baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until tuple, flag, threshold and reset semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, stale/generic logs, wrong source, missing/unexpected reset, boot failure, lost I/O or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/console and reimage path.
No register write without mask and saved full value.
One verified target once; abort on wrong source/severity, boot loop or missing durable evidence.
No automatic retry/reset; preserve crash records.
expected_evidence: Single injection plus OOB reset/boot timeline
test_case.recovery: Define containment and reset anomalies, boot-loop/reimage escape, IOHUB-dependent device restoration and exact threshold/Platform First/NBIO/FCH/HDT rollback. Execution remains blocked until approved.
